summary: Annie steps out of the crystal into a red sky. Hitch is still there, and the people who stopped a trade at the village now have to look at her.

segments.ja: 結晶の細い線が、今日は割れ目になります。割れ目から、アニが出てきます。出てくる体は、長い眠りのあとで自分の足を探します。探す空は、すでに赤いです。赤い理由は、壁の列が歩き、光が塵で濁っている、です。濁った光の下で、ヒッチがまだ同じ場所にいます。いることが、眠りが無人ではなかった証拠です。証拠の赤が、歩く列の塵と混ざります。
segments.en: The thin line in the crystal becomes a crack today. From the crack, Annie comes out. The body that comes out looks for its own feet after a long sleep. The sky it looks for is already red. The reason it is red is that the row of the walls is walking, and the light is clouded with dust. Under the clouded light, Hitch is still in the same place. Her being there is the proof that the sleep was not unattended. The red of that proof mixes with the dust of the walking row.

segments.ja: ヒッチは、憲兵の席からこの殻の番をしていました。していた年月を、彼女は任務の続きとして話します。話す声は、怒っても、去りません。去らない理由は、中の人がまだ名前を持っている、です。持っている名前を、アニは最初、自分の耳で確認します。確認したあと、彼女は外の音を聞きます。聞く音は、街の声ではなく、地を踏む列です。踏む列の速さを、彼女はまだ自分の足では測れません。
segments.en: Hitch has been keeping watch on this shell from a Military Police seat. She talks about the years she did that as a continuation of duty. The voice that talks, even angry, does not leave. The reason it does not leave is that the person inside still has a name. Annie first confirms the name she has with her own ears. After confirming, she hears the sound outside. The sound she hears is not a town's voice. It is a row trampling the earth. She cannot yet measure that speed with her own feet.

segments.ja: 同じ夕焼けの道を、コニーとガビとファルコが来ます。来る三人は、村で取引を止めたあとの列です。列の足は、まだ揃っていません。揃っていないまま、彼らは結晶のあった場所へ近づきます。近づく理由は、凍っていた戦士が目を開けた、という知らせです。知らせを、ジャンとアルミンも別の遅れで受けます。受ける空が、みんなの顔を同じ赤にします。同じ赤が、結晶のあった地面まで続いています。
segments.en: On the same sunset road, Connie, Gabi, and Falco come. The three who come are the row after the trade was stopped in the village. Their feet are not yet aligned. Without being aligned, they approach the place where the crystal was. The reason they approach is the news that the warrior who was frozen has opened her eyes. Jean and Armin receive the news too, on another delay. The sky that receives them turns everybody's face the same red. The same red continues as far as the ground where the crystal was.

segments.en: Annie looks at the walking walls with her own eyes. The row she looks at is a scene that was not there before she entered the shell. At the center of the scene that was not there is Eren's name. Mikasa still holds that name as the person of the scarf. Annie does not question the holding at once. The reason she does not question it is that she too abandoned a person's form for a long time. The time she abandoned and the march of now do not look like the same length of guilt. She makes the difference she cannot see into the first task outside the shell.

segments.ja: ジャンは、アニの前で銃を完全には下ろしません。下ろさない理由は、女型の力を覚えている、です。覚えている力と、今の細い体が一致しません。一致しない顔を、アルミンは会話の相手にします。する会話は、敵の宣言ではありません。ではありません。歩いている列を止めるなら、誰が同じ道に残るか、です。残るかどうかの答えは、この夕焼けでは出ません。出ない答えのあいだ、銃は膝の上に残ります。
segments.en: In front of Annie, Jean does not fully lower the gun. The reason he does not lower it is that he remembers the Female Titan's power. The power he remembers and the thin body of now do not match. Armin makes the face that does not match into a person for a conversation. The conversation he makes is not a declaration of an enemy. segments.ja: ミカサは、夕焼けの輪の端にいます。いる端から、彼女はエレンの行進の方向を見ています。見ている方向を、止めるという言葉はまだ受けません。受けない理由は、マフラーの相手を標的の語で呼びたくない、です。呼びたくない顔を、アニは理解します。理解するのは、自分も一人の名のために戦いを曲げたことがある、です。ある理解は、同盟ではありません。ではありません。同じ赤の下にいる、という事実です。
segments.en: Mikasa is at the edge of the sunset circle. From the edge she is at, she is looking in the direction of Eren's march. She does not yet receive the word stop for the direction she is looking. The reason she does not receive it is that she does not want to call the person of the scarf by the word target. segments.titleEn: The flags do not become one
segments.ja: 夕焼けが暗くなるとき、旗は一つになっていません。なっていない人々は、それでも同じ方向を見ています。見ている方向は、行進と、フロックの噂と、リヴァイの息です。息が届くまで、この輪は決定を持ちません。持たないまま、彼らは夜の移動を始めます。始める背中を、ヒッチは殻の場所から見送ります。見送る赤が、今日の最後の色です。最後の色の下で、決定はまだ言葉になっていません。
segments.en: When the sunset darkens, the flags have not become one. The people who have not become one are still looking in the same direction. The direction they are looking is the march, Floch's rumor, and Levi's breath. Until the breath arrives, this circle does not hold a decision. Without holding one, they start the night's movement. Hitch sees off the backs that start, from the place of the shell. The red of seeing them off is the last color of today. Under the last color, the decision has not yet become words.

segments.ja: 今日の言葉です。夕焼けは、アニが結晶から出た時刻の色です。ヒッチは、殻の番をやめませんでした。やめたのは、中の人が外に出てからです。コニーとガビとファルコ、ジャンとアルミンとミカサが、同じ赤の下にいます。フロックの噂は、この集まりを裏切りとして追います。ハンジの問いは、友を止めるかどうかです。答えは、今日は出ません。出ないまま、輪は夜の移動を始めます。始める足は、赤い空を背にして、まだ決定を持っていません。
segments.en: Today's words. Sunset is the color of the hour Annie came out of the crystal. Hitch did not quit the watch of the shell. She quit it after the person inside came out. Connie, Gabi, Falco, Jean, Armin, and Mikasa are under the same red. Floch's rumor chases this gathering as betrayal. Hange's question is whether to stop a friend. The answer does not come today. Without it coming, the circle starts the night's movement. The feet that start, with the red sky at their backs, still do not hold a decision.

vocab.exampleEn: The thin line in the crystal becomes a crack today. From the crack, Annie comes out. The body that comes out looks for its own feet after a long sleep. The sky it looks for is already red. The reason it is red is that the row of the walls is walking, and the light is clouded with dust. Under the clouded light, Hitch is still in the same place. Her being there is the proof that the sleep was not unattended. The red of that proof mixes with the dust of the walking row.
